meta.name: Define tag attach request and response schemas

gaps.gap: Whether a tag with no remaining links is deleted or kept is undecided. Keeping them makes an autocomplete list easy and lets the list rot.

context.prd-excerpt:
Feature "Tag links" (tag-links, should-have): Attach zero or more free-text tags to a link, and filter the list endpoint by tag.
Tags are a separate table with a many-to-many join to links, not a comma-separated string column. This is the one place the fixture deliberately requires a real relationship: a single-table shortcut would make the data-model layer trivial and the fixture would stop exercising the part of layer planning most likely to break.
User story: As someone collecting links, I want to tag what I save and filter by tag, so that a shelf of two hundred links stays usable.
Considerations: Tag names are matched case-sensitively. Case folding is a reasonable product decision but it is not free to verify, and leaving it explicit here stops an implementer inventing either behaviour and calling it correct. This is an implementation constraint carried from the feature's notes/considerations block; it is NOT an acceptance criterion and has no id.
The gap carried in the gaps block above is tag-links gap 1, kind=decision, raised 2026-08-27, blocking=true. It is carried verbatim and UNANSWERED. Consequence for this task: neither schema carries a cascade, retention or orphan field, because the decision has not been made. Do not invent one.

# Pydantic v2, bundled with FastAPI 0.110+ from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field from pydantic import ValidationError # raised on invalid input; used by the tests

task.objective: Create app/schemas/tag.py defining the Pydantic request model for attaching one or more free-text tag names to a link, and the Pydantic response model reporting a link together with every tag attached to it.

requirements.requirement: Create the file `app/schemas/tag.py`. It contains schemas only: no SQLAlchemy models, no route handlers, no database access, and no imports from `app.models` or `app.db`.

File imports:
from datetime import datetime from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field

Define the response model `LinkWithTags`:
class LinkWithTags(BaseModel): model_config = ConfigDict(from_attributes=True)
id: int url: str title: str | None created_at: datetime tags: list[str]
- The first four fields mirror `LinkRead` exactly, so a tagged link serialises the same way an untagged one does in the listing. - `title` is `str | None` with no default, so the key is always present in the serialised output and an untitled link reports null rather than omitting the field. - `tags` is a list of tag NAMES as plain strings, not Tag objects and not id/name pairs. An empty list is valid: a link may carry no tags. - `from_attributes=True` allows construction from an ORM Link object in task L3-006.

Do not define a `Tag` or `LinkTag` schema in this file, and do not re-declare the SQLAlchemy models of those names. `Tag` and `LinkTag` are database models created by task L4-003; the API surface exposes tag names as strings only.

Add no cascade, retention, orphan-handling or tag-deletion field to either model. The orphan-tag decision is an open, unanswered gap (tag-links gap 1); inventing a field for it would silently answer it.

test-requirements.test:
Create test file: `tests/test_tag_schemas.py`
Module imports:
import pytest from datetime import datetime from pydantic import ValidationError from app.schemas.tag import LinkWithTags, TagAttach
These tests need no database and no fixtures: they exercise the schemas directly.

Test: test_tag_schemas_carry_posted_names_and_report_every_attached_tag This test covers NO acceptance criterion and therefore carries no `covers` attribute. It verifies requirements 3 and 4 of this task: the field names, types and validation rules of the two schemas. Every criterion of tag-links describes endpoint behaviour, which this task does not build and this test does not exercise.
TagAttach: - single = TagAttach(tags=["python"]) Assert single.tags == ["python"] - multiple = TagAttach(tags=["python", "web", "reading list"]) Assert multiple.tags == ["python", "web", "reading list"] Whitespace inside a name is preserved, because names are free text. - untouched = TagAttach(tags=[" Python "]) Assert untouched.tags == [" Python "], proving no stripping and no case folding. - with pytest.raises(ValidationError): TagAttach(tags=[]) An empty list is not "one or more". - with pytest.raises(ValidationError): TagAttach() The tags field is required.
LinkWithTags: - model = LinkWithTags(id=7, url="https://example.com/a", title="A", created_at=datetime(2026, 1, 1, 12, 0, 0), tags=["python", "web"]) payload = model.model_dump() Assert payload["tags"] == ["python", "web"], every attached tag, in the order supplied, with no folding and no reordering. Assert payload["id"] == 7 Assert payload["url"] == "https://example.com/a" Assert payload["title"] == "A" Assert payload["created_at"] == datetime(2026, 1, 1, 12, 0, 0) - untitled = LinkWithTags(id=8, url="https://example.com/b", title=None, created_at=datetime(2026, 1, 2, 12, 0, 0), tags=[]) Assert "title" in untitled.model_dump() Assert untitled.model_dump()["title"] is None Assert untitled.model_dump()["tags"] == [] # a link with no tags is valid - case_sensitive = LinkWithTags(id=9, url="https://example.com/c", title=None, created_at=datetime(2026, 1, 3, 12, 0, 0), tags=["Python", "python"]) Assert case_sensitive.model_dump()["tags"] == ["Python", "python"] This last assertion is for the case-sensitivity constraint carried from the tag-links notes/considerations block, not for the criterion.

exports.interface:
# in app/schemas/tag.py from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
class TagAttach(BaseModel): """Request body for POST /links/{link_id}/tags."""
tags: list[str] = Field(min_length=1) # Required. At least one name. Names are free text, carried through exactly as # submitted: not stripped, not case-folded, not deduplicated, not sorted.
# JSON shape: # {"tags": ["python", "web"]} # An empty list, or a missing tags key, is a 422.

# in app/schemas/tag.py from datetime import datetime from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict
class LinkWithTags(BaseModel): """Response body for POST /links/{link_id}/tags: a link and every tag on it."""
model_config = ConfigDict(from_attributes=True)
id: int url: str title: str | None # always present in the payload; null when untitled created_at: datetime tags: list[str] # tag NAMES; an empty list is valid
# JSON shape: # {"id": 7, "url": "https://example.com/a", "title": "A", # "created_at": "2026-01-01T12:00:00", "tags": ["python", "web"]}
